## Star-delta start

A large three-phase motor starts in star (reduced voltage) then switches to delta (full voltage). Each connection is closed by a contactor: a line contactor, a star contactor and a delta contactor.

| Variable | Role | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | starts the motor | push button (true while pressed) |
| `stop` | stops the motor | push button (true while pressed) |
| `km_line`, `km_star`, `km_delta` | line, star and delta contactors | outputs |
| `fan` | motor cooling | output |
| `blink_sw` | blinker enable (optional) | switch |
| `indicator` | blinker indicator (optional) | output |

### Specification

1. After a press on `start`, the motor starts in star for 5 s (`km_line` and `km_star`), then switches to delta (`km_line` and `km_delta`).
2. `stop` stops the motor at any time (stop priority).
3. Star and delta are never closed at the same time: program the interlock (an NC contact of the other contactor in each network). On a real machine it is also wired, here the program must guarantee it.
4. The fan stays active for 10 s after the motor stops (after `km_line` drops).
5. Optional: a dead time (for example 200 ms) between star and delta; an adjustable blinker (1 s off, 1 s on) made of two crossed `TON`s, enabled by `blink_sw`.

texts.startTimeDescription: The TON measures the time spent in star.
texts.starDescription: Star during start-up, interlocked by the delta.
texts.deltaDescription: Delta after the delay, interlocked by the star.
texts.fanDescription: The TOF extends the ventilation by 10 s after the motor stops.
texts.blinkOffDescription: First TON, armed as long as the second one has not finished.
texts.blinkOnDescription: Second TON, armed during the on phase.
texts.indicatorDescription: The indicator follows the on phase.
